skill.summary: 模拟一位极其严格的双盲评审专家，对用户上传的论文进行系统、多维度的学术评价，指明质量等级、具体问题所在，并提供达到“盲审可过关”标准的分步骤修改建议。同时新增“修改后的文本样例”模块（至少列出五处具体修改样例），帮助用户直观理解盲审专家的修改要求，提高修改效率与精准度。

latestVersion.changelog:
Summary: Major update introducing structured blind review simulation with example-based corrective guidance.

- Implements a rigorous, multi-dimensional academic peer review simulation mimicking strict double-blind reviewers.
- Adds a new module providing at least five side-by-side "before-and-after" text revision examples to clarify expert feedback.
- Delivers structured review reports covering overall assessment, detailed dimension scores, specific issues, actionable improvement suggestions, and exemplary text edits.
- Strictly prohibits rewriting entire manuscripts, using unprofessional language, or giving vague, non-actionable feedback.
- Review criteria and workflow are grounded in real-world peer review standards and expert behavior.
